cases.required_behavior: Reject reused PID with changed creation time; do not bind stale parent lineage.
An observed executable-file digest is not loaded-image provenance; unknown cannot authorize actions.
Managed protocol session binding and configured hook ancestry agree on project/session scope.
Ambiguous/shared hook ancestors remain nonexclusive and protected.
Incomplete global process coverage cannot prove an orphan or disposal safety.
Required or contradictory evidence unknown produces insufficient evidence, not confirmed root cause.
Stale health/profile data and changed installation digest invalidate old correlations.
Unsupported version/protocol returns an explicit unsupported result without fallback shell execution.
Dirty tracked, untracked or ignored content blocks cleanup even with manual quiescence.
Local-only commits, work in progress, submodules and missing coverage remain protected.
Expired/unreleased primary session is uncertain and blocks cleanup.
Main worktree, bare repository and locked worktree removal are refused.
Work Item/worktree/branch/file overlap is reported without killing or switching owners.
Changed HEAD/status/path identity after preview invalidates removal.
Preservation ref is created only with zero-old/no-overwrite semantics and survives failures.
Nonforce removal cannot delete a branch or invoke broad prune.
Destination parent identity replacement, broken link and access denied never mean empty.
Worktrunk uses exact empty config and declines remote CI/summary collection or project hook execution.
Created worktree is verified against requested repository/HEAD/branch; partial creation not automatically destroyed.
Configured lifecycle events are scoped and idempotent where applicable; turn-end does not end a session.
Same external session ID in different project/vendor cannot merge history or authority.
Hook-reported decisions are proposals, never silently accepted.
Local credential rotation failure before/after file write preserves existing head or records an orphan encrypted file.
Compare-and-swap rejects concurrent/stale secret-version transitions.
Revoked head cannot fall through to a legacy ciphertext resolver.
Credential generation change invalidates pending effects in the affected environment.
Wrong user/machine/tampered DPAPI value fails; recovery status distinguishes metadata from decryptability.
Reports, MCP, plans, arguments, journal errors and share output contain no injected secret canary.
Existing availability is based on fresh scoped profile evidence, not mere catalog membership.
Adoption produces separate resource/decision proposals without applying or accepting them.
Revision changes invalidate applicability; saved/dismissed feedback stays appropriately scoped.
Copilot unknown/unlimited quota and missing/reset-changing timestamp do not produce a fabricated runway.
Account-isolated caches cannot mix two integrations with the same provider or label.
Claude missing statusline window stays unknown; cost remains estimated not subscription debit.
Gemini cumulative session tokens never appear as remaining subscription or context capacity.
Bad/negative/nonfinite numeric fields are rejected without recording raw provider text.
Copilot Content-Length rejects duplicate/oversized/truncated frames and noncorrelated results.
Unexpected protocol revision or permission/options response rejects continuation before prompt.
Configured providers cannot invoke arbitrary host tools; unadvertised ACP load/auth/mode remains unsupported.
Resume binds the exact project/workspace identity and does not displace an existing primary.
Failure/timeout preserves uncertain ownership and does not declare tests or Work Item done.
Only old terminal records are archived; running/indeterminate entries stay in active storage.
Crash before/after each archive write/transaction is recoverable without losing logical history.
Tampered/missing archive pack or entry digest fails hydration rather than hiding data loss.
Backup database and archive companions restore together into a new home only.
Archive file/count limits stop optional archival; approved records and required backups are preserved.
Fresh install, v1/v2/v3 to v4 migration, failure rollback and source manifest remain coherent.
13 read-only MCP tools and cached context perform no external effects or unexpected scans.
Windows lock/job/pipe teardown, Unicode/reparse/ACL coexistence and no C fallback pass on actual host.
Authenticated real multi-agent task and quota exercises are explicitly authorized and independently reported.
